Google Employee Arrested Over Child Pornography Content

A Google employee has been arrested in Uttar Pradesh, India, on charges of possessing and distributing child pornography content. The arrest was made possible through a tip from the US-based National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC). The incident highlights concerns over online safety and the need for effective measures to combat child exploitation.
